ui.tooltip: Save an edited mask before Keep, Discard, Next or Previous. If saving fails, stay on this image without recording a verdict. Off by default; Skip still writes no mask.
ui.placement: Immediately after Next in the Make Masks toolbar

behavior: When enabled, edited mask pixels are saved before Keep, Discard, Next or Previous; a failed save prevents movement and curation. Manual Save and Box saving retain their existing behavior. Skip does not save a mask.

validation.environment: Python 3.12.13, PySide6 6.11.2, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, 4 GiB cgroup cap
validation.limitations: Focused local CPU checks; no hosted CI or full serial acceptance claim

handoff: Workstation owns translation catalog and guide prose refresh for the two new tr() strings; Qt source/test ownership is Home.
